Class DemoFile

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.rl.DemoFile
public final class DemoFile extends Object
The user's own fights, step by step, for the network to learn from (/swordai demo; the user, 22 October: "I can do later but make it so I can start when I want"). Each step holds what the network would have seen there (picture, numbers, its reading of the opponent, the tactic), the action the person took as the network would have had to choose it (HumanAction), which heads were the network's to choose there (the rules take some), and the reward the training gives for it. One gzipped file a fight.

Loaded (Learner.loadDemos), the steps go into a SilBuffer with their returns and are imitated the way self-imitation imitates the network's own best steps: only where the person did better than the critic expects of the network (Oh et al., 2018; demonstrations kept and learned from beside the agent's own play as in Hester et al., DQfD, 2018). A person's mistakes are not learned.

    • returns

      public static float[] returns(float[] reward, boolean[] terminal, float[] value, float gamma, float lambda)
      Lambda-returns of a fight, as Rollout.computeAdvantages makes them: reward already scaled, value the critic's for each step. A fight that was not ended by a knockout or the clock goes on from its last step as the critic expects of it.

    • wentTheirWay

      public static boolean[] wentTheirWay(float[] reward, int window)
      Which steps were followed by a stretch that went the person's way: the reward of the window ticks from the step on (as far as the fight goes) adds up to more than nothing. All of them for a window of 0.
